qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Swiss commercial office and retail portfolio possesses prime locations, but operates in a competitive asset management and leasing landscape without structural pricing power to overcome low single-digit unlevered property yields.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3 (Moat & Pricing: ROIC 3.2-4.3% vs 12% hurdle; archetype 'None', REJECT). Largest Swiss listed commercial real estate owner; despite prime properties and inflation-linked leases, capital efficiency is structurally capped at 3-4% ROIC, failing the Munger quality hurdle.
qualitative.evidence: Reported group ROIC is 3.2-4.3% (and 3.2-3.8% excluding revaluation effects). Net initial property yields of 3.2-4.2% structurally limit unlevered capital returns, far below the 12% hurdle across all business cycles.
